clips.caption:
How much old baggage are you carrying around?

Kevin Trudeau asks you to picture every hurt you've collected: names you were called as a kid, a breakup, a business betrayal, a colleague who lied about you, even guilt over something you did.

Each one goes into the bag. He says it all weighs you down and stops you from going forward.

Which piece of luggage would you set down first?
